summary: United Community Banks, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing completion of the sale of its equipment finance subsidiaries, Navitas Credit Corp. and NLFC Reinsurance Corp., to funds managed by Wafra Inc. for approximately $2.0 billion in cash. The price reflects a 7% premium to the par value of Navitas's loan portfolio. The transaction, previously disclosed on June 11, 2026, advances United's focus on core Southeastern banking, enhances liquidity and capital strength, and simplifies its business model. BofA Securities acted as exclusive financial advisor. Watch for capital deployment and any related balance-sheet impacts.
